user.title: Retention Cleaner
user.description: Configure a folder cleanup rule. Choose either a file pattern OR extension filters (not both).

data.pattern: File pattern (glob) - leave empty if using extension filters

error.base_path_not_media: The base path must start with /media/ or /share/.
error.run_at_invalid: Daily run time must be in HH:MM format.
error.pattern_too_broad: This pattern matches ALL files! Please be more specific to avoid accidental data loss.
error.pattern_invalid_syntax: Invalid glob pattern syntax. Check for unclosed brackets or invalid wildcards.
error.retention_days_too_large: Retention days cannot exceed 3650 (10 years). Please enter a reasonable value.
error.extension_must_start_with_dot: Extensions must start with a dot (e.g., .mp4 not mp4).
error.extension_no_paths: Extensions cannot contain path separators (/ or \).
error.extension_too_short: Extension is too short. Must have at least one character after the dot.
error.must_set_pattern_or_extensions: Must configure either pattern or extension filters.
error.cannot_combine_pattern_and_extensions: Cannot use both file pattern and extension filters. Choose pattern OR extensions.
error.cannot_use_both_only_and_except: Cannot use both 'only extensions' and 'except extensions' filters.
